publicPreviewSummary: Build confidence in client conversations, handle objections and practice practical negotiation skills.
capstone: A fictional discovery-call script, two-option proposal, negotiation log and respectful follow-up playbook

modules.learningObjective: Understand real client needs and capture realistic decision criteria
levelTitles: Prepare for a First Client Conversation
Ask Questions Before Presenting a Service
Listen for Unstated Client Concerns
Clarify Budget and Decision Timeline
Summarize Client Needs Without Assumptions

modules.moduleTitle: Presenting offers and ethical objection handling
modules.learningObjective: Make transparent commercial proposals and respond respectfully
levelTitles: Propose a Clear Scope and Deliverables
Explain Value Without Invented Promises
Respond to an Unclear Budget Objection

Offer Alternatives Without Pressuring the Client
Checkpoint: Present a Two-Option Offer
modules.exampleScenario: Respond to an Unclear Budget Objection

modules.learningObjective: Handle competing priorities with honest terms and clear limits
levelTitles: Prepare Negotiable and Fixed Boundaries
Choose a Fair Concession in a Scenario
Handle a Competitor Price Comparison
Explain Payment Terms Without Ambiguity
Document a Respectful Disagreement
Checkpoint: Agree on a Transparent Next Step

modules.moduleTitle: Follow-up, client retention and conversation capstone
modules.learningObjective: Manage post-sale communication, concerns and ongoing client trust
levelTitles: Write a Useful Post-Meeting Follow-up
Record Next Steps and Client Ownership
Respond to a Delayed Client Decision
